name: Greenhouse whitefly
shortDescription: NZ's biggest greenhouse pest. Tiny white flies on the underside of leaves.
symptoms: White fly on leaf undersides; sticky honeydew; sooty mould on leaves and fruit.
chemicalNotes: Spinosad or pyrethrum as a last resort; rotate actives.
preventionTips: Fine mesh on all vents and doors

name: Tomato-potato psyllid
shortDescription: Serious NZ Solanaceae pest causing psyllid yellows.
symptoms: Sugar granules on leaves; yellowing and stunting; deformed fruit.
chemicalNotes: Spinosad as a last resort; observe withholding periods.
preventionTips: Mesh under 0.35 mm on all openings

name: Aphid
shortDescription: Cluster on new growth and spread plant viruses.
symptoms: Clusters on shoot tips; curling leaves; sticky honeydew.

name: Two-spotted spider mite
shortDescription: Tiny mite that thrives in hot, dry greenhouses.
symptoms: Yellow stippling on leaves; fine webbing on undersides; bronzing.
chemicalNotes: Sulphur dust if severe — not within 30 days of oils.

name: Western flower thrips
shortDescription: Slender insects that vector tomato spotted wilt virus (TSWV).
symptoms: Silvering of leaves; black faecal specks; distorted flowers and fruit.
preventionTips: Monitor with blue sticky traps weekly

name: Fungus gnats
shortDescription: Black flies around seedlings; larvae chew roots.
symptoms: Black flies on soil surface; weak seedlings; wilting despite damp soil.

name: Caterpillars
shortDescription: Various moth larvae that chew leaves and bore fruit.
symptoms: Holes in leaves; chewed flower buds; tunnels in fruit; frass.
preventionTips: Floating row cover at risk times
Monitor for eggs on leaf undersides

name: Mealybug
shortDescription: White cottony clumps on stems and leaf joints.
symptoms: White cottony masses; sticky honeydew; sooty mould.
organicControls: Methylated spirits on a cotton bud
preventionTips: Inspect new plants before bringing in
Wipe pots and benches at season end

name: Slugs and snails
shortDescription: Papamoa humidity brings them to greenhouse perimeters.
symptoms: Ragged holes in leaves; silver slime trails; shredded seedlings.

name: Scale insects
shortDescription: Brown limpet-like insects on stems and leaf veins.
symptoms: Brown limpets on stems; yellowing leaves; honeydew and sooty mould.

name: Citrus leafminer
shortDescription: Silver trails inside new citrus leaves.
symptoms: Silver serpentine trails in young leaves; curled, distorted flush.
organicControls: Neem or horticultural oil on new flush

name: Passion vine hopper
shortDescription: Bubbly spit on passionfruit and citrus stems.
symptoms: Frothy white spit; sooty mould; weakened new growth.
